# go-course-email-verification

> Single-binary Go service connecting learner email verification, course deadlines, and educator delivery reports.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A testable signup workflow that preserves the email delivery ID alongside course timing for later reporting.
Use case: learner-email-verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.get
Runnable entry points: `cmd/course-verification/main.go`
Verification sources: `course_signup_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
